title: Monkey reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- monkey body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#D2A16B'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='21' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#E8C79A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='38' r='8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#E8C79A'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#E8C79A'/>
  <!-- eye brows / eye area -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='42' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#F5E4C8'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='42' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#F5E4C8'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#2B1B3A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#2B1B3A'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='42.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='42.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose and smile -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#6B4226'/>
  <path d='M45 54 Q50 58 55 54' stroke='#6B4226' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <path d='M30 66 Q34 74 40 72' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 66 Q66 74 60 72' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book open -->
  <path d='M32 66 L50 62 L50 84 L32 88 Z' fill='#3FBF7F'/>
  <path d='M68 66 L50 62 L50 84 L68 88 Z' fill='#57D99B'/>
  <path d='M50 62 L50 84' stroke='#2A8C5C' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <path d='M36 71 L47 68 M36 76 L47 73 M36 81 L47 78' stroke='#F5E4C8' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 68 L64 71 M53 73 L64 76 M53 78 L64 81' stroke='#E8F7EE' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little hands on book -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='4' fill='#D2A16B'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='4' fill='#D2A16B'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 88 Q84 86 82 70 Q80 62 74 64' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
